title: VTG 1968 Dallas Summer Musicals My Fair Lady Program Douglas Fairbanks Jr
categoryName: Entertainment Memorabilia:Theater Memorabilia:Souvenir Programs:Other Theater Programs
descriptionText:
Original vintage 1968 Dallas Summer Musicals program for My Fair Lady.
Starring Douglas Fairbanks Jr. and Margot Moser. Features cast listings, production details, and vintage advertisements including Zenith stereo.
Condition:
Pre-owned with visible wear from age. Some edge wear, light creasing, and minor corner damage. No major tears or missing pages. Please see photos for exact condition.
